candidates.description: German masculine and neuter genitive/dative singular and accusative masculine singular pronouns and determiners.
This feature vector activates strongly on German auxiliary, modal, and copula verbs across various tenses and moods.
This vector represents third-person personal pronouns and related grammatical gender markers across German and English.
This vector activates strongly on the German letter 'ä' and words or subwords containing it.
This vector activates strongly on German words and subword tokens containing the "acht" letter sequence or rhyming phonemes.
This vector represents the German surname component and root "Lud" along with common Germanic name suffixes and morphological variations.
This vector represents the concept of German language, culture, and geography.
This feature vector activates strongly for historical figures, regimes, and major events associated with 20th-century European totalitarianism and World War II.
